svg.aria-label: A grid of muted CTA-blue tiles on a deep navy field, with a single clean rectangular region in the upper-left where the tiles are absent and the dark ground shows through, traced by a thin electric-blue line.
svg.title: The $20B blind spot — a missing operational view
svg.desc: A clean orthogonal grid of small filled tiles in muted CTA-blue and slate covers most of the frame. A single rectangular region in the upper-third-left has no tiles — the dark navy ground shows through. The empty region's edge is traced in a thin confident electric-blue line so the void reads as deliberate, not unfinished. The missing tile is the visualization.
